create_prompt_history_entry: create a new prompt history entry with snapshot, user_id, and optional commit message
get_prompt_history_by_id: get all prompt history entries for a specific prompt_id with pagination support
compute_prompt_history_diff: compute a unified diff between two prompt history entries by their history IDs
delete_prompt_history_entry: delete a single prompt history entry and reparent its children to the grandparent
get_latest_prompt_history: get the most recent prompt history entry for a given prompt_id
